  rw [intDegree, num_one, denom_one, sub_self]

  rw [intDegree, num_C, natDegree_C, denom_C, natDegree_one, sub_self]

  rw [intDegree, num_X, Polynomial.natDegree_X, denom_X, Polynomial.natDegree_one,
